title: TypeSafe Noul documentation
text: A Noul evaluates a yes/no question and returns the probability of yes. Authors supply instructions describing their question. Optional true and false criteria define the two outcomes. The question ID is bookkeeping and is not itself sent as an instruction to the model.

title: TypeSafe Choice documentation
text: A Choice selects among supplied labels with descriptions. Its response includes a selected label, probabilities and confidence. Include a no-match label when the available options might not fit the input.

title: Node SQLite API
text: Node supplies a SQLite interface including prepared statements and bound parameters. A database can persist application records and query tables without a separate database server.

title: TypeSafe Daggerverse uv module
text: The uv Dagger module packages Python workspace projects into containers and relocatable environments. It can include the Python interpreter and audit locked dependencies. These operations concern Python project packaging.
